title: ER cardinality markers follow Mermaid's placement: the almond is half buried in the box

v:
## Context

Amends the Consequences of `01M4VP6AVMYHJ9HDE0KST32ATA` (ER markers stay on their runs); its text is left as written. That decision kept each end of an ER route straight for as far as its marker reaches, and the reaches were Siren's (ADR-0004: every glyph outside the entity box, `refX = markerWidth`): 15, 27, 42 and 54. It left open adopting Mermaid's half-buried almond, which would shorten the two "many" reaches.

Mermaid 12.2.0's `_neo` end markers (`node_modules/.pnpm/mermaid@12.2.0/node_modules/mermaid/dist/chunks/mermaid.esm/chunk-RLXJHMIZ.mjs` lines 1163-1199, the ones an ER diagram is drawn with) place the glyphs as follows, as distances out from the box (`refX - x`): `onlyOneEnd` bars at 9 and 15 (reach 15); `zeroOrOneEnd` bar at 9, circle centred 21, `r` 6 (reach 27); `oneOrMoreEnd` `refX` 27 of 45, bar at 24, almond 9 to 45, so from 18 out to 18 inside (reach 24); `zeroOrMoreEnd` `refX` 39 of 57, circle `cx` 11 so centred 28 out (reach 34), almond 21 to 57, again 18 out to 18 in. The start markers are these mirrored (`refX` 0 or 18), except that `zeroOrMoreStart`'s circle sits at `cx` 45.5, 27.5 out where the mirror is 28. The user approved following Mermaid's placement on 2026-10-14 (ticket issue `01M4W5YJ3B68REDBADWB371DV3`).

## Decision

The ER renderer places the cardinality glyphs where Mermaid 12.2.0's end markers place them. A "many" marker attaches at the middle of its almond, so half the almond lies inside the entity box. The glyphs' figures are unchanged: a bar, a hollow circle of radius 6, and an almond made of two quadratic curves 36 long. One definition per cardinality with `orient="auto-start-reverse"` draws the start end as the mirror. Siren does not copy the 0.5px asymmetry of `zeroOrMoreStart`.

- `buildMarker` takes a `refX`. The bar and circle markers keep `refX = markerWidth`. `oneOrMore` is 45 wide with `refX` 27, and `zeroOrMore` is 57 wide with `refX` 39. Every glyph lies inside the marker's own viewport, so nothing is clipped.
- `CARDINALITY_MARKER_REACH` (layoutErDiagram) is now 15 / 27 / 24 / 34. A render test requires the table to equal the reach of each drawn marker, so a table longer than its marker would fail as well. The test that holds every route end to its marker still passes.
- The buried half is hidden because the entity is painted after every line (ADR-0016, Mermaid's `edgePaths → nodes`). The entity frame is filled with `--siren-node-fill` (opaque `#f3efff`) and carries no opacity of its own. A render test over `er-subgraphs`, a self-relationship document, and every cardinality in TB and LR checks two things for each almond end. First, the buried 18 × 18 half lies inside the rectangle of the entity it touches, including a box with an attribute table. Second, that entity's group comes after the line's group. The test also checks that the frame rule is opaque.

ADR-0004 still holds for stroke and colour, which belong to the theme. What changed is the "every glyph outside the box" choice, which was Siren's own. Siren now follows Mermaid here.

## Evidence

The span of the boxes (from the parity report's `--json`), Siren before → after (Mermaid 12.2.0; Siren before `01M4VP6AV`):

- `er-subgraphs`: 340×1622 → 330×1422 (Mermaid 280×1321; 315×1271)
- `er-long-labels`: 1212×418 → 1212×378 (Mermaid 1166×304; 1212×335)
- `example-er-core` (LR): 1797×244 → 1707×244 (Mermaid 1439×264; 1623×244)
- `example-er-reveal`: 204×489 → 204×489, because its routes are straight (Mermaid 164×509)

On `er-subgraphs`, the growth over the pre-`01M4VP6AV` span falls from +351px to +151px along the ranks, and on `example-er-core` from +174 to +84. That is roughly half.

Parity against Mermaid 12.2.0 (headless Chrome) on the four ER fixtures, unchanged: crossings 0 against 0, through unrelated boxes 0, vertical 97.2%, horizontal 100%, failures 0, through titles 1 (Mermaid 2), reversals 2 against 2. The full parity run shows the other kinds unchanged: flowchart crossings 176 / 176 and 99.6% / 97.8%; class (4 fixtures) 97.4% / 100%; state 100% / 98.5%; 0 edges through unrelated boxes; 0 failures.

## Consequences

ER pictures stretch along the rank axis about half as much as under `01M4VP6AV`. The straight run a "many" end needs drops to 24 or 34px plus the corner cut. Ends with a "one" marker are unchanged. Mermaid's routes still bend sooner than its markers reach (`01M4VP6AV`'s Context). Siren keeps its departure there: each end stays straight for as long as its marker. Half of a "many" almond is now hidden by its entity box, so a theme that makes `.siren-er-entity-frame` translucent will show it. The default theme does not.
